【原视频简介】
Another quiet and meaningful day unfolds here on the farm. In today’s video, I take care of my farm animals and harvest a fresh basket of homegrown vegetables from the garden. I share a little piece of the harvest with my animals, then pack up the rest to give to my lovely neighbor. In return, a basket of rice paddy is shared back - a simple,rustic exchange filled with local warmth and community love.
If this slice of peaceful country life brings comfort to your day, please give it a thumbs up, subscribe, and share your thoughts below!
